subject: an elephant carrying cloud-like pages
art_direction: 灰蓝小象背上托着一本无字小书，书页像一小片厚云展开。
visible_description: 灰蓝小象背上托着一本无字小书，书页像一小片厚云展开。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Sculpt a small blue-gray elephant carrying an open blank book whose thick pages resemble a compact cloud. Curl the short trunk inward and keep the feet firmly planted, giving the eyes thoughtful sweetness. Use matte painted clay and warm ivory page edges. Soft side light on a pale sage field creates a tender storybook object without text or extra scenery. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
